I'm an American, so what i think of when i think of my Grandma is entirely different XD

But! two things come to mind:

Baked Macaroni and Cheese (made with a pound or so of cheddar and mozzarella, if not more XD)
Homemade Chicken Salad, made with rotisserie chicken, seasoned salt, grapes, and mayonnaise.

Both were made in portions that were enough to feed about 20-30 people each year, and we used to come over around the holidays to help my grandmother with days worth of cooking. 

Just about everyone we could invite came to her house-- friends, neighbors, family from across the country-- the food and company were always worth trip. My uncle would man the grill until dark, us kids played in her massive backyard until the fireflies came out, and we'd play music so loud that you could hear it down the street lol

She's sadly gone now, and I miss gathering at her house for holidays like we used to, but we still make those dishes every year. <3
